# Download the plugins here

These are the installable jars:

- [Blazentenance-Velocity.jar](Blazentenance-Velocity.jar) — put this in the Velocity `plugins/` folder
- [Blazentenance-Paper.jar](Blazentenance-Paper.jar) — put this in every Paper server `plugins/` folder

On GitHub, open a jar file, then click **Download raw file** (the download icon on the right). There is no download button on the pull request page itself.
